Imo if it happens they will shut off DNS. That means you will no longer be able to go to www.whatever.com .

However - if you know the IP address you just type that in your browser to resolve.

If I do an nslookup on my windows command prompt I can find the IP address to voat.com.

In other words:

Nslookup yahoo.com

Resolved to - 98.137.246.7

If you type https://98.137.246.7 you will be directed to yahoo.com. You are essentially acting as the dns server and you’ve resolved the text url with IP.

Note - you would need to have these IP addys ready before the DNS is shut down.
